tool.name: AEGeAn LocusPocus
tool.description: Compute interval loci (iLoci) from gene annotations in GFF3 format
tool.command: mkdir -p locuspocus_output for input_file in $input_gff; do locuspocus "$input_file" > "locuspocus_output/$(basename "$input_file")" done cat locuspocus_output/* > $output_gff

param.name: input_gff
param.label: Input GFF3 files
param.help: One or more GFF3 files containing gene annotations

file.name: test_input.gff
file.content: ##gff-version 3 chr1 test gene 100 200 . + . ID=gene1 chr1 test gene 150 250 . + . ID=gene2

tool.help:
# LocusPocus: Compute interval loci (iLoci) from gene annotations
## Purpose LocusPocus computes interval loci (iLoci) from gene annotations in GFF3 format. Each iLocus represents a single gene, a set of overlapping genes, or the space between genes.
## Input - Input must be one or more valid GFF3 files - Optional ##sequence-region pragmas can influence iLocus computation at sequence ends
## Output - iLoci locations in GFF3 format - Includes attributes for number of genes and transcripts in each locus
